decision.title: Node, sequence, string and type functions (packet )
decision.summary: One options reader serves every option map, and new node, sequence, string and type functions, fn:parse-xml-fragment and fn:system-properties are added, with collations resolved by the ordering functions.

body.p: . F&O 4.0 sections are those of the current editor's draft.

item.p: One options reader (glossary ): sxml_function_library_read_options (src/function_library_options.c, declared in src/function_library_core_internal.h) reads every map that follows the option parameter conventions (1.7): a definition is a name and a sequence type; values are coerced with sxml_evaluator_coerce; a string key that names no option is XPTY0004, an xs:QName key in a namespace is ignored. The string and JSON parts use it (their own readers are gone); the element-map, resource and serialization-parameter readers of other packets could move to it.
xnode()? for fn:name, local-name, namespace-uri, node-name, base-uri, document-uri, nilled (as F&O 4.0 types them): a JNode is XPTY0004 (QT4 PathExpr-J-461, -462).

Node functions (src/function_library_node.c): siblings (the parent's child step); innermost/outermost in document order (a node's subtree follows it, so only the next member, or the last kept one, needs an ancestor walk); lang (caseless by full lower-case mapping); id, element-with-id and idref scan the target document for the is-id / is-idrefs nodes the parser marks (xml:id, DTD ID/IDREF/IDREFS), FODC0001 for a root that is not a document; path in every 4.0 form; location from the tree's get_location (tree_internal.h), as an fn:location-record: the processor's loader does not keep locations, so documents it parses give the empty sequence, which F&O allows; fn:doc accepts and ignores $options.

parse-xml-fragment (src/function_library_json.c): the entity, after a UTF-8 byte order mark and a text declaration (which must have an encoding and no standalone, else FODC0006), is parsed by the loader as the content of an element of a document made around it, whose children are copied into a new document node; binary input is taken as UTF-8. strip-space="all" (both parse functions) copies through a tree builder that drops whitespace-only text outside xml:space="preserve". system-properties (17.1.9) lives in the same part: the 14 built-in properties, sxml not schema-aware and without the optional features.

Type part src/function_library_type.c (19.1): type-of; schema-type, atomic-type-annotation and node-type-annotation make an fn:schema-type-record from the type registry; base-type, primitive-type, members and matches are anonymous function items over native rows that capture the type identifier as xs:integer; constructor is the type's constructor body (as xs:T#1), absent for xs:anyAtomicType, xs:anySimpleType and namespace-sensitive types; variety "mixed" for xs:anyType and xs:untyped; xs names carry the xs prefix.
Sequence part: starts-/ends-/contains-subsequence as one resumable body (): one call of $compare per step; without it fn:deep-equal's leaf entry, no calls.

Collations ('s proposal for these bodies, accepted): fn:min, fn:max, fn:highest, fn:lowest, fn:sort-by, array:sort and array:sort-by resolve through sxml_function_library_find_collation / _resolve_collation and compare with _compare_collated; each sort key definition carries its collation (the default when a sort key record names none). sxml_higher_order_check_collation is gone; sxml_function_library_check_collation has no caller left (its definition in src/function_library.c may go). Order-by keys in the evaluator's SORT still accept only the codepoint collation.

Not done: a descending range for count(reverse(1 to 10^11)) (one QT4 case, RangeExpr-408g; needs a frozen-header addition, see "Proposed"); the zero comparison bug in src/xdm_atomic.c (Proposed). Survey (every fn/map/array/math name of the XP40 sets, function-lookup at arities 0 to 6): 26 functions missing, all of packets , , , or 's non-goals (html-doc, parse-html, invisible-xml, xsd-validator, transform).
